title: KM VMS 0.8.0 — Reasonable Core Reconstruction and Universal Direct Updates
summary: Simplifies the in-app update path and supports direct updates from older releases through the canonical migration registry without mandatory intermediate application releases.
changelog: Reduces update admission and control to one durable request, one helper execution and the minimum topology required by the read/write privilege boundary.
Allows supported older installations to update directly through the canonical migration registry without mandatory intermediate application releases.
Stops only for a genuinely active helper, schema mutation or proven incompatible database state; terminal history no longer blocks a new request.
Keeps mutation_started false until the first real schema, preparation or recovery mutation, allowing safe recovery from pre-mutation failures.
Preserves restart-tolerant status and recovery, compact application confirmation and bounded localized errors without raw backend response text.
Validates representative 0.7.18 and exact-schema-8 0.7.28 paths, tampered-history rejection, API restart recovery and healthy product services.
Registers 0.7.29 as the immediate schema-equivalent predecessor for the 0.8.0 release.
Keeps atomic release-slot activation and automatic post-activation rollback in the separate planned Stage 6.6.1.
